content.title: Taylor Swift’s net worth hits new milestone
content.text: Skip to content(Gray News) - Taylor Swift’s net worth has hit a new milestone.Swift’s net worth is now worth an estimated $2 billion, according to Forbes.FILE - Taylor Swift appears at the MTV Video Music Awards in Elmont, N.Y., on Sept. 11, 2024.(Evan Agostini | Evan Agostini/Invision/AP)Her net worth includes the nearly $800 million earned from royalties and touring, a music catalog worth around $600 million and more than $100 million in properties throughout the United States.Swift is the first musician to reach the billionaire milestone through her songs and performances versus outside projects.Copyright 2026 Gray Local Media, Inc.
